resumen: The same push as with a barbell, but each arm on its own. You can go deeper and you have to stabilise twice as much.
ejecucion: Lie on the bench with a dumbbell in each hand, at chest height.
Press up until your arms are straight, without clashing the dumbbells.
Lower under control until your elbows are level with your torso or slightly below.
Keep your elbows at about 45° from your body, not flared out.
Keep your feet on the floor and your back on the bench throughout.
matices: In the cited study the maximum weight with dumbbells was 17 % lower than with a barbell, and yet deltoid activation was higher: the less stable the exercise, the less load moves and the more stabilising work there is. It is not better or worse than the barbell, it is a different split.

fuentes.titulo: A comparison of muscle activity and 1-RM strength of three chest-press exercises with different stability requirements
fuentes.autor: Saeterbakken et al., J Sports Sci, 2011
